newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate falls, baht eases.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate falls, baht eases.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate eased to 8.00 percent during late trade on Friday from 8.50 in the morning after imported foreign funds boosted liquidity in the afternoon, dealers said.
"Imported funds brought in through the swap market pushed the interbank rate down in the afternoon from around 8.50 percent in the morning," said a dealer at a U.S. bank.
The baht eased to 25.435-25.440 to the dollar near the close on late dollar buying from 25.428-25.433 in the morning, dealers said.
